description: This Java class 'SmsCampaignEnumerations' provides utility methods to convert enum values related to SMS campaigns into 'EnumOptionData' representations, such as trigger types, campaign types, month types, and period frequency types.

classes.name: SmsCampaignEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class for mapping SMS campaign related enum types to 'EnumOptionData' objects.

methods.name: smscampaignTriggerType
methods.description: Converts a 'SmsCampaignTriggerType' enum value into an 'EnumOptionData' object with appropriate label.

methods.name: smscampaignType
methods.description: Converts a 'CampaignType' enum value into an 'EnumOptionData' object with label.

methods.name: calendarMonthType
methods.description: Creates an 'EnumOptionData' object for a given Month enum value.

methods.name: calendarMonthType
methods.description: Returns a list of 'EnumOptionData' objects for all months except December, for use in dropdowns or selections.

methods.name: calendarPeriodFrequencyTypes
methods.description: Converts an array of 'PeriodFrequencyType' enums into a list of 'EnumOptionData' objects.
